== Released date and exact published wording ==
The printed sheet and accompanying image use <code>3 force</code>, while the 21 July 2012 card-list capture uses <code>3 Force</code>. The earlier Released bound has been removed because that capture establishes the capitalized card-list wording rather than this lowercase printed wording. The printed wording is retained. Sources: Players Committee, [https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock1.pdf#page=3 VirtualBlock1 printed release sheet], page 3; [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064754/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VMasterType.html Virtual Cards: Master List], captured 21 July 2012. The sheet’s text-as-of date is not being substituted for a publication date.
